description: Minified source code of DataTables plugin version 1.10.16, a jQuery-based table enhancement library. The file includes module definitions, class and method implementations, and internal logic for table rendering, sorting, filtering, pagination, and other features.

classes.name: s
classes.description: Main DataTables API class providing methods for table manipulation and data access.

methods.name: dataTable
methods.description: Initializes or retrieves a DataTable instance on a selected HTML table element.

methods.name: columns
methods.description: Returns column-related API methods for visibility, ordering, and data access.

methods.name: rows
methods.description: Provides access to row data, nodes, and indexes.

methods.name: cells
methods.description: Provides access to cell data, nodes, and indexes.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the DataTable instance and cleans up associated resources.
